names.howResolved: FIXED_MAIN_CODE (main code was wrong). Teardown after context-metadata delivery exhaustion was never confirmed. GuidedSessionService.stop addressed the one monotone stop to the unacknowledged bootstrap context, which the runner never received. The runner refused it: backend saw 409 UNKNOWN_OUTCOME; the runner-side IDENTITY_MISMATCH at ownership.ts:153 is inferred from source. teardownStatus therefore stayed PENDING, and the @AfterEach teardown oracle timed out after 10 s. Fix: when the translation bootstrap is CONTEXT_PENDING without metadataAcknowledgement and an assignment exists, the stop goes to the assignment. The runner always holds the assignment once claimed, and the assignment stop stops any runtime under it. Still one stop, no retry, and a lost ack still never confirms.
names.evidence: DIAG run r1: context stop FAILED 409 UNKNOWN_OUTCOME, teardownStatus PENDING, materialization/assignment live=false. After the fix (r2, DIAG): assignment stop OK, CONFIRMED, PASS. Without DIAG, r10 full class: this case PASS. Regression in r10: GuidedBridgeIntegrationTest 37/37, GuidedSessionIT 43/43 and GuidedServiceTransportFaultIT 21/21 PASS, including the 'missing stop ack never confirms teardown' cases.

names.howResolved: BLOCKED_PRODUCT_DECISION (see DECISION-1 (Planning model-input budget)). Verified cause: STUDIO-OBS-007's required prompt additions (secret-login output-contract paragraph, +701 bytes; v3 response schema with secretRef/passwordControl) raised the reserved input per model request. Reservation = wire bytes + 2048, and settlement never refunds. The same 3-step clarify-plus-restart fixture flow was measured on 2026-10-09 with the pre-OBS-007 contract (outputContractHash 60d57376..., equal to the HEAD contract hash): 8 proposals, 121,589 reserved, avg 15,199. Not changed: raising the ceiling, changing accounting, trimming the OBS-007 contract, or lowering the test's ceiling would each be a product decision or an assertion weakening.

C6 fails 2 of 2 in class order and passes isolated. OBS-007 only ever proved both in single-case runs.
